svg.title: Force 3 — Lost intimacy: the mental model before and after AI agents
svg.desc: Two side-by-side scenarios showing how a developer's mental model of a codebase changes when code is agent-written versus human-written. Left panel shows a connected, lit-up mental map. Right panel shows dark, disconnected nodes.
svg.text: developer wrote or reviewed every node
developer never read any of this code
"When it breaks, you are not reconstructing intent.
You are reverse-engineering a decision process that was never explained and no longer exists."
